provenance.canonical_layout: SEC XBRL company-concept payloads for the revenue, operating income and depreciation and amortization concepts, each the byte-exact company-concept response with the facts the API does not yet carry taken from the filing's own inline XBRL instance, plus the canonical price series and acceptance evidence reused by path from data/historical_pe/AEP. The trailing revenue and EBITDA windows are the ones the data/historical_multiples/AEP dataset divides by.

concept_fetch.transport: HTTPS GET data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyconcept/CIK0000004904/us-gaap/{tag}.json with a declared contactable User-Agent, honouring the SEC fair-access policy, with the facts the response does not yet carry taken from the filing's own inline XBRL instance
concept_fetch.response_units: verbatim as returned: USD for every concept
concept_fetch.filing_instance_supplement: The company-concept API did not yet carry the FY2026 second-quarter 10-Q (0000004904-26-000059, accepted 2026-07-30, period 2026-06-30), although that filing reports the same elements the capture already held. The facts it does carry were therefore read from the filing's own inline XBRL instance, consolidated facts only, keeping each fact's accession, acceptance datetime, context, period, unit and source URL.

revenue_concept.json.definition: The revenue role's element, us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, the registry's own EXACT source for the revenue metric. The element AEP's income statement headlines, us-gaap:Revenues, was retired by registry decision 2.99 -- its own definition is broader than the metric, because it allows investment and interest income -- and no scope was invented to rescue it for any issuer, including this one.

operating_income_concept.json.definition: Operating income as presented, after the operating expenses that include depreciation and amortization.

depreciation_concept.json.definition: AEP's cash-flow line 'Depreciation and Amortization', carried on us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseDepreciationAndAmortization. The amortization of nuclear fuel is a separate cash-flow line, so this line is depreciation and amortization and nothing else. The element is a utility-sector element, so the registry maps it to the metric for AEP alone and not as a market-wide EXACT mapping -- the same treatment Apple's own element receives.

daily_prices.json (reused by path).source: The canonical daily price series, read by path. The trading calendar decides when a filing's fact becomes knowable under the 16:00 ET cutoff rule, so one calendar serves every reconstruction of this issuer.

filing_acceptance_evidence.json (reused.source: The canonical acceptance index, read by path. A fact whose filing is not in the index has no knowability evidence in this dataset and is skipped.

known_limitations: The revenue role's element is the registry's contract-revenue element, whose own coverage begins with the fiscal 2023 annual figure. The trailing revenue window therefore exists only for the evaluation dates from late 2025 onward, which is why the P/S distribution holds four qualifying observations and is reported as short a sample rather than as a reference.

Microsoft's own fiscal declarations contradict each other about one period: the fiscal 2021 first-quarter 10-Q labels the quarter ended 2021-03-31 as fiscal 2020 Q3, a position its own fourth-quarter 10-Q already holds. The windows that need that position are refused with REASON_FISCAL_POSITION_UNRESOLVED, because the facts are in the capture and nothing says which fiscal quarter they are.
The acceptance index starts at 2019-01-24, so the earliest evaluation dates have no trailing revenue window and are refused rather than backfilled.
